date_note: FinCEN's statement was issued on Tuesday per Türkiye Gazetesi's article of 25 November; resolved to 24 November.
geo_basis: agency headquarters, Washington DC (US Treasury unit)
title: FinCEN says unauthorized access hit a limited part of its systems, Türkiye Gazetesi reports
summary: Türkiye Gazetesi reports that the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN), a US Treasury unit, said in a statement on Tuesday it is investigating a cybersecurity incident involving unauthorized access to a limited part of its systems. The article says FinCEN took some systems offline as a precaution and that banks can still file suspicious activity reports online. The article says the scope and source were not disclosed.
plain: A Turkish newspaper reports that FinCEN, a US Treasury unit, says it is investigating unauthorized access to a limited part of its systems and took some systems offline as a precaution.
exec: FinCEN holds banks' suspicious activity reports; per the article, the scope and source of the access were not disclosed.
action: General advice: banks with urgent reports should use the help line the article says was not affected; otherwise no action needed.
